title: Whiteboard: The last mile: 17 states from done to main
about: One board draws the whole line, so the person reads every state and move in one place.

understood.label: You asked
understood.text: Draw the state machine on a whiteboard I can read.

sections.heading: The line, drawn
sections.body: Each shape is one state; each line is a move between two of them.

board.title: The last mile: 17 states from done to main

shapes.label: coding
shapes.note: The worker is still on it: its last status line is not done.

shapes.label: ready
shapes.note: The worker said done, and the proof for that commit is not complete yet, so the landing check does not start it.

shapes.label: admitted
shapes.note: The proof is complete and the change waits for the landing check to start it.

shapes.label: landing
shapes.note: The landing is under way right now.

shapes.label: refused
shapes.note: The landing was refused: it waits, is tried again, or needs a new commit, as the reason says.

shapes.label: landed
shapes.note: The change is on the trunk. No home was moved to it yet.

shapes.label: home-behind
shapes.note: A go-live for the change was tried, and no home runs it yet: the move failed or was rolled back.

shapes.label: live-partial
shapes.note: Some homes run the change and others do not.

shapes.label: cleanup-refused
shapes.note: The change landed, and the lane's cleanup was refused, so its record and work copy still stand.

shapes.label: release-open
shapes.note: The change is in the open release pull request, and no CI run has reported on its head.

shapes.label: release-ci-running
shapes.note: The change is in the release pull request, and CI is running on its head.

shapes.label: release-red
shapes.note: The change is in the release pull request, and CI failed on its head.

shapes.label: release-green
shapes.note: The change is in the release pull request, every check passed, and it is not merged yet.

shapes.label: merged
shapes.note: The release pull request that holds the change merged, and the next trunk is not cut yet.

shapes.label: rolled
shapes.note: The change is on the main branch and a new trunk was cut after it.

shapes.label: reverted
shapes.note: The change was reverted on the trunk and does not run.

arrows.label: done
arrows.note: the worker appends a done line for its head

arrows.label: proof
arrows.note: bin/jg-trunk.sh proof finds the receipt, the merge-card evidence and the sealed run at the head

arrows.label: start
arrows.note: no landing runs and the flush rule lets the lane go

arrows.label: land
arrows.note: bin/jg-trunk.sh land or land-batch writes the lane's data/trunk-landings.tsv row

arrows.label: refuse
arrows.note: the lander refuses; the state file holds wait, retry or final with the reason

arrows.label: retry
arrows.note: a wait on each sweep and on the start a finished landing chains after its 2 minute backoff, a retry after that backoff, a final conflict once the trunk tip it…

arrows.label: live
arrows.note: every home moved to a commit that holds the change, and the project's live row is written

arrows.label: partial
arrows.note: some homes moved to a commit that holds the change

arrows.label: behind
arrows.note: the move to a commit that holds the change failed or was rolled back in every home

arrows.label: partial
arrows.note: a later move reached some homes

arrows.label: live
arrows.note: a later move reached every home

arrows.label: live
arrows.note: the homes left behind moved

arrows.label: release
arrows.note: a release pushes a trunk commit that holds the change

arrows.label: release
arrows.note: a release pushes a trunk commit that holds the change

arrows.label: release
arrows.note: a release pushes a trunk commit that holds the change

arrows.label: release
arrows.note: a release pushes a trunk commit that holds the change

arrows.label: run
arrows.note: a CI run starts on the pull request's head; no script records it yet (row 42)

arrows.label: red
arrows.note: a check failed on the head before the run was read as running

arrows.label: green
arrows.note: every check passed on the head before the run was read as running

arrows.label: red
arrows.note: a check failed on the head

arrows.label: green
arrows.note: every check passed on the head

arrows.label: push
arrows.note: a fixed trunk head is pushed into the same pull request; no script does it by itself yet (row 46)

arrows.label: revert
arrows.note: the change is charged with the red and reverted on the trunk

arrows.label: merge
arrows.note: the guarded merge, when the owner's rule allows it

arrows.label: rollover
arrows.note: the landing check cuts the next trunk from the main branch

arrows.label: refused
arrows.note: bin/jg-teardown.sh refuses the lane's cleanup after the landing

arrows.label: cleaned
arrows.note: the sweep's unforced cleanup removes the lane record

arrows.label: x1-ci-red
arrows.note: CI is red at a live commit, so the green pin and every home move back to the last green commit

arrows.label: s18-revert
arrows.note: a hand-run whole suite charges the change with a red and reverts it

steps.title: From the done line to the landing
steps.text: The worker says done. The proof must be complete before the landing check starts the lane.

steps.title: A landing lands or is refused
steps.text: A refused landing waits, is tried again, or needs a new commit, as its reason says.

steps.title: Reaching the homes
steps.text: A landed change is live only when every home runs it.

steps.title: The release pull request
steps.text: The change rides the release pull request through CI to main.
